purpose: Teach: 稀/読み方/目先/義父/うるさく/柔らかい/恥ずかしく/嫁さん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、稀、絶対、な、絶対、お豆、絶対、お店に入れたわ
lines.en: Sho, we finally got into that rare-bean café you wanted to see.
lines.style: Bright, almost bubbling with excitement. Quick opening. Warm and inclusive — she's proud to have made this happen for him. Light on the beat.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お店の名前の、本気で、絶対、読み方、絶対、教えて
lines.en: Mei-sis, what's the name of the place? How do you say it?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not performing. Leans in slightly. Small, clear voice — the kind of question a kid asks when he actually wants to know. Patient breath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、目先、絶対、の楽しみより、絶対、お勉強、絶対、頑張ってね
lines.en: Sho, don't get too caught up in the fun part — keep working on your studies, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirect, not a lecture. Warm but purposeful. The tone of someone who cares enough to say the thing even though it's not the fun thing. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、義父、絶対、って、絶対、優しい人?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, is your… your brother's wife's dad a kind person?
lines.style: Soft, testing question. He's asking something that matters to him. Slight hesitation before the family term — he's working out the word as he goes. Genuine, not casual.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、うるさく、絶対、なる、絶対、夜の時間、絶対、苦手なの
lines.en: Sho, I get loud in the evenings sometimes — it's just hard for me when it's night.
lines.style: Quiet admission. She's being honest about something small but real. Slight apologetic undertone, not performative. Trails gently, like she's not sure if she's explained it right.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、柔らかい、絶対、お声、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like how soft your voice is.
lines.style: Simple, direct observation. No self-consciousness — he's just saying something true he noticed. Warm and genuine. The kind of small comment that lands because it's unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、恥ずかしく、絶対、てもね、絶対、お友達、絶対、にあいさつしようね
lines.en: Sho, even though I'm embarrassed sometimes, let's say hello to your friends, okay?
lines.style: Gently pushing past her own discomfort. Soft but resolute. She's setting a small boundary about herself while keeping him included. Warm and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お兄ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、嫁さん、絶対、メイ姉さんも、絶対、知ってる?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, does your brother's wife — does she know you too?
lines.style: Small, probing question. He's trying to understand the shape of her life, where she fits. Careful tone — he's asking because he's wondering if she's lonely. Quiet attentiveness.
